messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: embeddings-prod-west p95 latency > 2s (2.4s) for 3m, error rate stable. paging oncall.
ashley: Acked. jumping in. any customer-facing impact yet?
sam: I'm on deck. looking at routing and model variant usage now.
ben: quick query — traffic to embeddings-prod-west is healthy, tail latency across model-v2 quantized spike. small bump in retry counts though.
ben: ```sql
SELECT bucket, p95 FROM telemetry.embeddings_latency
WHERE region='prod-west' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';
``` 
ben: results: p95=2.4s, p99=3.1s, retries +15% vs baseline.
priya: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood-infra/embed/emb-prod-west — top-left shows latency rollout aligned with a config change ~09:12 UTC.
natalie: @ben can you check if KV cache miss rate increased? that often explains seq-length regen.
ben: cache miss doubled for some sessions. looks like an eviction storm starting at 09:11.
sam: mitigation idea: force fallback to model-v1 (smaller KV footprint) for prod-west for next 15m and enable prefix caching warmup.
ashley: agree. do we have quick toggle? deploy-bot: can you confirm brownout rollback command?
deploy-bot: `runbook: switch-serving-variant --service embeddings --region prod-west --variant model-v1 --reason "latency spike"`
ashley: @deploy-bot run it please.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. executing... ✅ done. traffic shifted to model-v1 variant.
priya: watching dashboards — p95 dropped to 0.9s within 90s. retries trending back down.
oliver: customer impact check: queried support logs — only 3 customer errors tied to this window, churned requests but no bulk failures.
ashley: good. next: alert tuning and runbook updates so we don't page for transient eviction storms.
sam: propose: change embedding-p95 alert to trigger only if p95>1.5s for 5m AND error_rate > 1% OR client-visible SLO violation.
priya: also add an annotation to the alert rule: "possible KV-eviction storm — check cache-miss metric and model-variant distribution" and link to diagnostic dashboard.
priya: draft snippet for alert rule:
```
alert: embeddings-p95-high
expr: (p95>1.5 and since(p95, 5m)) and (error_rate>0.01 or slo_violation==true)
annotations:
  runbook: https://docs.redwood-infra/runbooks/embeddings-evictions
  owner: infra-sre
  notes: "check kv_cache_miss, model_variant_ratio"
```
ben: I'll open a PR in infra-alerts with that rule and add the dashboard link. assigning to @sam for review.
sam: will review ASAP. also propose a pre-squelch window: when p95>1.5 but cache_miss spike >2x, route alerts to #eng-oncall-silent (pager suppressed) for 3m while autoscaling or fallback engages.
ashley: hmm ok but we need explicit ownership during that quiet window. @oliver on night shift — can you own the "silent-handling" policy for the 00:00-08:00 shift?
oliver: I can. will accept ownership for night-handling and follow the runbook checklist.
ashley: action items:
- ben: open infra-alerts PR + add dashboard links + tag infra-sre (due in 1h)
- sam: review PR + add pre-squelch policy (due 2h)
- priya: update runbook doc with new play and annotated checklist (due EOD) — https://docs.redwood-infra/runbooks/embeddings-evictions
- oliver: oncall night owner for pre-squelch policy (ongoing)
- ashley: postmortem stub + customer impact blurb in incident tracker (I'll draft)

ben: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra-alerts/pull/452 — added dashboard and initial rule. requesting @sam review.
sam: reviewing now, left one nit about the annotation format.
priya: runbook patch draft (MD) ready: https://docs.redwood/changes/rr-789 — includes play steps, metrics to check, and rollback commands. please review.
ashley: perfect. I'm adding a short customer-facing note for CS: "Small latency bump for embeddings in prod-west resolved by automatic fallback. Minimal customer errors observed."
oliver: quick handoff note for night: if alert fires, follow runbook section "silent-handling" -> check cache_miss, scale kv-store, trigger fallback, then notify #tsc if >5% SLO impact.
ashley: closing loop — created incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/1850123456 and linked PR + runbook.
ashley: follow-ups will be tracked there. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 1850123456 moved to RESOLVED (duration 34m). notes: fallback applied, PR opened, runbook updated.
sam: thanks everyone. will merge alert-rule tweak after tests. thumbs up from me for the pre-squelch approach. :thumbsup:
priya: I'll add a short how-to in the runbook for annotating future alerts so ownership is explicit.
ben: leaving logs/queries in the incident tracker for postmortem.
oliver: night team notified, I added the quiet-hours rota to the runbook.
ashley: great work team, good mitigation and quick runbook actions. we'll take the postmortem tomorrow.
